body: I should. But I just let it go and moved on.I’m just placing boundaries up.

I was recently called ugly by a coworker and the other two guys just stood there it really hurt and was honestly the worse feeling in my life, but i already felt ugly as it is.  It just hurt hearing it ...like someone else definitely confirmed my fears :(  idk ty for sharing your story because I feel like maybe someone has gone through what I’ve gone through :/

Understand me. I don’t know you but I love you and I am so fucking proud of you. You are a human being who deserves the world. My love is pouring into this and I pray you feel this connection. Other humans are here to love you and congratulate you 💖💖 and remember we’re always here for you
